What is proven, and where

A miss is evidence, not proof: with d = 0.9 a searched bay keeps a little belief, and the others rise.

Tested: coco_lab/test/test_regionsearch.py::test_update_is_bayes_rule_against_the_enumerated_joint; coco_lab/test/test_regionsearch.py::test_a_find_is_certain_and_a_perfect_miss_is_proof

If every bay cost the same to reach from anywhere, "most likely per metre first" would be optimal. COCO's bays do not, so the robot costs every order.

Tested: coco_lab/test/test_regionsearch.py::test_index_rule_is_optimal_when_costs_do_not_depend_on_order; coco_lab/test/test_regionsearch.py::test_the_robot_order_is_no_worse_than_any_other_order

With a camera that can miss, nearest-first is beaten: a search that finds nothing drives the whole tour, so the tour's length counts.
